name: Greptile
desc: PR review agents with a graph index of your codebase
desc_zh: 先建仓库图谱再评审 PR 的智能体
solves: A diff shows what changed, not what it breaks. Greptile indexes the codebase first, then a swarm of agents reads the PR in that context.
solves_zh: diff 只告诉你哪里改了，会坏在哪里是另一回事。Greptile 先建图谱，再让一组智能体在这个上下文里读 PR。
best_for: A pull request that touches shared code and needs a second reader.
best_for_zh: 改动公共代码的 PR，合并之前想再有一双眼睛看过。
notes: Builds a dependency graph of the whole repo first, so it catches cross-file breakage a diff-only reviewer misses. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/greptile
